title: Immutability and Functional Collections

content.intro: In this lesson, you will learn **Immutability and Functional Collections** as part of **Functional Programming and Idiomatic Kotlin**. Kotlin functions can expose parameters and return types, and function values/lambdas allow behavior to be passed to or returned from other functions. Use the subtopics—Read-Only Data Structures, Transforming Instead of Mutating, Managing State Changes Explicitly—as a checklist: predict what the example will do, then verify it in a project configured for the target platform.
content.why_it_matters: These concepts help you model domain rules and reusable APIs. Good boundaries reduce accidental mutation, unsafe casts, and code that is difficult to extend.
